location: Azshara, behind the old stone gate
entrance: Behind the old stone gate in Azshara, where a furbolg tunnel opens at /way 38.7 33.4. The tunnel runs so deep that the portal itself is on the map of Winterspring, at /way 66.6 84.4.

96246.note: From Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarath. Not shareable.

92065.objective: Bring the head of Varrox Bleakhoof to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.
92065.note: Needs Neutral with Timbermaw Hold and Rageroar's own chain, which starts with The Legashi Threat from Ekkal. Choose one of four rings.

92069.objective: Bring the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken to Ogtinc.
92069.note: Withermaw drops the claws, Bonesnout the Unbroken the tusks.

92066.objective: Find the Totem of Ursoc and the Totem of Ursol inside and bring them to Lorekeeper Nok at Ursolan.

92070.objective: Find the owner of the Feathered Charm Necklace.
92070.note: Random monsters inside drop the necklace, for one player only. Bring it to Unele at Ursolan.

97173.objective: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97173.note: Elder Shaman Bloodmane drops the totem. Reputation with the Kirin Tor and Darnassus.

92344.objective: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold.
92344.note: Starts with Beneath Nordrassil in Azshara.

97198.objective: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97198.note: Elder Shaman Bloodmane drops the totem. Reputation with the Earthen Ring and Thunder Bluff.

92343.objective: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold.
92343.note: Starts with Beneath Nordrassil from Jediga in Azshara, /way 22.4 51.4.
